question: Where was the UAE’s first Sovereign Mobility Cloud unveiled?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dubai.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The UAE unveiled its first Sovereign Mobility Cloud at the Dubai World Congress for Self-Driving Transport, marking a key step in the country’s autonomous mobility strategy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Sovereign Mobility Cloud provides a secure, sovereign-enabled platform for hosting mobility data and autonomous system operations within UAE jurisdiction.**
 
• **All data and infrastructure are governed under UAE national regulations, ensuring data security and compliance.**
 
• **Autonomous mobility technologies integrated include LiDAR, AI, and GPS, enabling vehicles to navigate safely without human input.**
 
• **The initiative reflects the UAE’s commitment to advancing smart transport and autonomous vehicle strategies at a national level.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Sovereign Mobility Cloud__

 __
 
• A platform providing trusted infrastructure for autonomous vehicles and mobility data, fully hosted within UAE to ensure national regulatory compliance.
 
 
 
• Autonomous Mobility__
 __
 
• Involves vehicles operating with minimal or no human input using AI, LiDAR, and GPS to perceive surroundings, make decisions, and navigate safely.
 
 
 
• LiDAR Technology__
 __
 
• Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) is used to detect objects and map environments in 3D for autonomous navigation.
 
 
 
• Strategic Significance__
 
 
• The initiative strengthens the UAE’s leadership in autonomous transport, providing secure, locally governed digital infrastructure for future mobility innovations.
